post_text:
Day 3/30 — ArrayPool<T>.Shared for High-Throughput APIs (.NET & C#)

Allocating short-lived byte buffers on high-traffic endpoints keeps Gen0 GC constantly collecting.

• **Memory Rental:** ArrayPool rents pre-allocated chunks from thread-safe internal buckets with zero heap churn.
• **Buffer Length:** Rented arrays may be larger than requested, so always slice with AsSpan(0, count).
• **Try-Finally Discipline:** Returning buffers in finally blocks prevents pool depletion and silent leaks.

Watch out: Failing to clear sensitive payload data when calling Return can expose old tenant data to subsequent rentals.

Are you renting buffers or using MemoryPool<T> across your IO pipelines?
